questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'MSME: Meaning, Nature and Classification' refers to.
questions.a: Micro, small and medium enterprises are classified on the basis of investment in plant and machinery or equipment and annual turnover, and their nature includes flexibility, local resources, import substitution and export promotion in both manufacturing and services.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'MSME: Meaning, Nature and Classification'.
questions.a: The MSME definition on composite criteria of investment and turnover places micro, small and medium units in graded categories for policy support.

concepts.title: Role of MSME in India's Economic Development

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Role of MSME in India's Economic Development' refers to.
questions.a: MSMEs contribute to balanced regional development, employment generation, use of local resources, mobilisation of entrepreneurial skill, export earnings and equitable distribution of income, acting as ancillary units feeding large industries.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Role of MSME in India's Economic Development'.
questions.a: Small units reach remote areas with lower capital per job, so they promote balanced regional development where large industry cannot reach.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Role of MSME in India's Economic Development' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Role of MSME (source: kebs109.txt role of msme section)

concepts.title: Problems of MSMEs and Government Support

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Problems of MSMEs and Government Support' refers to.
questions.a: MSMEs face problems of finance, raw material, outdated technology, marketing and competition, while government support flows through schemes of credit, delayed payment protection, marketing assistance, technology upgradation and incubation under the MSME policy framework.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Problems of MSMEs and Government Support'.
questions.a: Delayed payments by large buyers and competition from cheap imports are chronic problems that policy answers with credit guarantees and marketing platforms.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Problems of MSMEs and Government Support' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: Problems and support (source: kebs109.txt problems and support sections)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Entrepreneurship: Concept, Functions and Process' refers to.
questions.a: Entrepreneurship is the process of setting up a new venture by an entrepreneur who perceives opportunity, arranges resources and bears risk for profit, performing functions of idea generation, opportunity scanning, feasibility study, business plan preparation and mobilising funds and manpower.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Entrepreneurship: Concept, Functions and Process'.
questions.a: An entrepreneur combines innovation, risk bearing and organisation, and entrepreneurship development programmes build the capacity that converts ideas into enterprises.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Entrepreneurship: Concept, Functions and Process' taught, and from which source text?
